verdict.rationale: Recruitee has a well-documented public REST API with token-based auth (Bearer), documented endpoints for candidates, offers, departments, locations, webhooks, and a Careers Site API, plus an llms.txt for machine-readable docs discovery. Missing for 10: a formally published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found 404s on standard OpenAPI paths) and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness.
